description: This file defines TypeScript interfaces, types, and imports for the Playwright testing library, specifically for generating type overrides. It includes interface definitions for Page, Frame, Browser, and other related classes, as well as external module imports and type aliases.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Interface representing a web page with methods for evaluation, element selection, and event handling.

classes.name: PageAgent
classes.description: Interface for extracting data from a page with schema validation.

classes.name: Frame
classes.description: Interface representing a frame within a page, with evaluation and element handling methods.

classes.name: BrowserContext
classes.description: Interface for managing browser context, including script injection and event listeners.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Interface representing a browser instance with event management.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Interface for evaluating scripts within a worker context.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Interface representing a JavaScript handle for evaluating scripts and retrieving values.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Interface for DOM element handles with methods for querying and evaluating within elements.

classes.name: Locator
classes.description: Interface for locating and evaluating elements with timeout options.

classes.name: BrowserType
classes.description: Interface for connecting to browsers over different protocols.

classes.name: CDPSession
classes.description: Interface for Chrome DevTools Protocol sessions.

classes.name: WebSocketRoute
classes.description: Interface for WebSocket message and close event handling.

classes.name: errors.TimeoutError
classes.description: Custom error class for timeout errors.

classes.name: ElectronApplication
classes.description: Interface for evaluating scripts in Electron applications.

methods.name: Page.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the page context.

methods.name: Page.evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: Page.addInitScript
methods.description: Injects a script into the page before any other scripts run.

methods.name: Page.$
methods.description: Selects a single element matching the selector.

methods.name: Page.$$
methods.description: Selects all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: Page.$eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on an element matching the selector.

methods.name: Page.$$eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: Page.waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element matching the selector to appear.

methods.name: Page.exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a binding to the page.

methods.name: PageAgent.extract
methods.description: Extracts data from the page using a schema.

methods.name: Frame.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function in the frame context.

methods.name: Frame.$
methods.description: Selects a single element within the frame.

methods.name: Frame.$$
methods.description: Selects all elements within the frame.

methods.name: Frame.$eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on an element within the frame.

methods.name: Frame.$$eval
methods.description: Evaluates a function on all elements within the frame.

methods.name: Frame.waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element within the frame.

methods.name: BrowserContext.exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a binding in the browser context.

methods.name: Browser.removeAllListeners
methods.description: Removes all event listeners of a specific type.

methods.name: BrowserType.connect
methods.description: Connects to a browser instance.

methods.name: CDPSession.send
methods.description: Sends a command via Chrome DevTools Protocol.

methods.name: errors.TimeoutError
methods.description: Error class for timeout errors.

methods.name: ElectronApplication.evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a script in an Electron application context.
